text:
Introduction
It adopts high-quality and high-speed network intelligent and PoE chip
This PoE switch has 24 port 10/100/1000M PoE + 2 Gigabit Ethernet Uplink + 2 Gigabit SFP enjoying
seamless connection for 10/100/1000M Ethernet
three working modes
one-key smart simple switching working mode
easy to manage and maintain
802.3af and 802.3at standard for each PoE port
intelligent detection of powered devices
power the devices that comply with the IEEE802.3af or IEEE802.3at standards
transmit only data to non-PoE devices
With simple and convenient installation, maintenance methods and rich business features, it helps users build a safe and reliable high-performance network
It is mainly located in the core or convergence layer of user  networks such as industrial parks, buildings, factories and mines, government agencies, and residential broadband
It can be widely used in Ethernet  access scenarios such as small and medium-sized enterprises, Internet cafes, hotels, and schools
Key Features
24*10/100/1000M PoE Ports + 2*Gigabit Ethernet Uplink + 2*1000M SFP Port
Comply with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE802.3ab, IEEE802.3z, IEEE802.3af/at standards
Ethernet port supports 10/100/1000M adaptive and PoE functions
PoE priority is supported, from port 1 to port 24, which is enabled by default
The AI mode is automatically enabled 10M speed for Ports 17~24 in Extend mode
Flow control mode: full-duplex adopts IEEE 802.3x standard, half-duplex adopts Back pressure standard
Support port auto flip (Auto MDI/MDIX)
Automatically supplied to adaptive devices
Panel indicator monitoring status and help failure analysis
Support VLAN mode, OFF mode and Extend mode
Support PoE Watchdog
Support port lightning surge: common mode 4KV, differential mode 2KV; Electrostatic ESD: air 8KV, contact 6KV
1U Rack installation
Specification
Product Name	28 Port 10/100/1000Mbps Rack Type Ethernet PoE Switch
Port	24 Port 10/100/1000M PoE + 2 Gigabit Ethernet Uplink + 2 Gigabit SFP
Switching Capacity	56Gbps
Throughput	41.644Mpps
Packet Buffer	6M
MAC Address	8K
Jumbo Frame	9216Kbytes
Transfer Mode	Store and forward
MTBF	100000 hours
Network protocol	IEEE 802.3: Ethernet Media Access Control (MAC) protocol / IEEE 802.3i:10BASE-T Ethernet / IEEE 802.3u:100BASE-TX Fast Ethernet / IEEE 802.3ab:1000BASE-T Gigabit Ethernet / IEEE 802.3z:1000BASE-X Gigabit Ethernet (Optical Fiber) / IEEE 802.3x: Flow Control
PoE Protocol	IEEE802.3af(15.4W) / IEEE802.3at(30W)
PoE Wiring	1/2(+), 3/6(-)
PoE Budget	400W
Industry Standard	EMI: FCC Part 15 CISPR (EN55032) class A / EMS: EN61000-4-2 (ESD) / EN61000-4-5 (Surge)
Network Medium	10Base-T: Cat3,4,5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 100Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m) / 1000Base-TX: Cat5 or above UTP(≤100m)
Optical Media	Multi mode fiber : 50/125, 62.5/125, 100/140μm / Single mode fiber: 8/125, 8.7/125, 9/125, 10/125μm
Certification	CE/FCC/RoHS
Working Environment	Working Temperature: -10℃~50℃ / Storage Temperature: -40℃~70℃ / Working Humidity: 10%~90%, non-condensing / Storage Temperature: 5%~95%, non-condensing
Power	Power Input Voltage: AC100-240V
Internal AC-DC Converter: 52V7.69A
LED Indicators	PWR(Power indicator) / On: power on
Off: no power / 1-28 ACT(Link&Data) / On: Connected / Off: Disconnected / Flashing: Data Transmitting / 1-24 1000M(Yellow Light) / On: PoE power supply is normal / Off: PoE not powered / PoE Max PoE power light / Off: PoE power usage is less than 90% / Flashing: PoE power usage of 90%≤ P≤ 95% / On: PoE power is used at 95%<P<100% / Mode DIP Switch light / On: Extend on / Off: Extend off / PoE Led Key / Dual color light selection / Default green (link data), Switch yellow light (PoE)
Extend DIP Switch	OFF: Normal mode, all interfaces can communicate with each other / The transmission distance is less than 100 meters, the transmission rate is 10/100/1000M adaptive; The port AI mode is disabled / ON: Link extension mode, 17-24 ports force 10M, link 250M (enable PoE watchdog), The port AI mode is enabled
Dimension
Remark

Packing Information
1pc switch(neutral device)
1pc power cable(standards vary across countries)
1pc user manual(including QIG information)
1pair mounting brackets(rack mountable)
Please know that there is NOT a warranty card in the packing box
A “Warranty Certificate” will be issued to indicate the order information and warranty coverage
Shipping box information(Below information is approximately accurate)
Product size: 440*205*44mm
Inner box size: 500*290*85mm
Product weight: 2.86Kg
Packing weight: 3.39Kg
Master box size: 520*445*310mm
Packing quantity: 5Pcs
Packing weight: 17.95Kg
Remark
Accessories(optical module, patchcord etc.)are NOT included in the packing box
Please prepare it by yourself or purchase a whole set from us
Power adapter is included in BOTH the packing box AND unit pricing
